title: Lolli's mate
line: A pawn on f6 and the queen landing on g7.

steps.text: Lolli's mate: a white pawn has pushed all the way to f6, next to the castled king. Black's bishop that guarded g7 is gone.
Tap the white piece that guards g7.
steps.hint: A pawn captures one square forward on a diagonal.
steps.after: The pawn guards g7, so a queen there cannot be taken by the king.

steps.text: Bring the queen next to g7 with a quiet move. It is not check, but Black cannot stop the mate that follows.
steps.hint: The queen goes along a diagonal to the edge of the board, beside g7.
steps.after: Black has no piece that can guard g7, and no way to give the king room.

steps.hint: The queen lands on the square the pawn guards.
steps.after: Lolli's mate. The pawn guards the queen, and the queen takes every square around the king.

summary: A pawn deep beside the castled king guards a square for the queen. A quiet queen move can make the mate unstoppable.
